segments.t: Accept A Task Unfinished from Antur Fallow. On the speedrun, move on once the local quests turn green; lower-level kills give less xp than in Classic.

tips.text: Antur Fallow is on the road north to Bloodhoof Village; his quest ends at the Bloodhoof inn.

tips.text: Speedrun: take every Bloodhoof quest at once; most objectives overlap on the plains around the village.

segments.t: Turn The Adventurer in to Kaga Wildhoof, then sit at Kaga's campfire until the rest buff lands and turn in The Great Outdoors.

tips.text: Campfire buffs (Fish Bowl +8% stats at Fishing 20, and other players' camp items) are optional. The route works with none of them. A Camp Tent only fills rested xp up to 5% of a level and does nothing if you already have more.
Cooking a basic meal gives Well Fed: +5% kill xp for 15 minutes, if you keep food on hand. The route does not require it.
